description: Listings API is a local citation and listings submission API: one REST call submits a business to 50+ listings sites Google Business Profile, Apple Maps, Bing Places, Facebook, Yelp, and the rest of the major directories, maps, and answer engines and keeps its name, address, phone, and hours in sync everywhere it appears. Manage business locations, listings, reviews, posts, and local analytics. Monitor listing status, respond to reviews, publish posts and analyze performance.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
